_comment: Pinned exceptions for scripts/validation/dead-exports.mjs (task #374). Every entry is an exported symbol under client/src/ or shared/ that NO other module imports — pre-existing findings from when the symbol-level gate was introduced. This list is MECHANICALLY shrink-only: the gate carries a frozen manifest of exactly these file#symbol keys and fails on any entry outside it, so adding or substituting entries here does nothing but fail the gate (allowlist-growth). The only allowed edit is REMOVING an entry together with resolving its export (delete it, drop the `export` keyword, or wire it up); stale pins (symbol imported again, or gone with the entry left behind) also fail. The analytics helpers this gate was filed over are NOT pinned — they were deleted, which is what every new finding must do. Task #392 swept this list from 110 to 53: everything used only inside its own module lost the `export` keyword and everything with no reference anywhere was deleted. The 50 remaining vendored shadcn/ui entries are pinned PERMANENTLY by a settled decision (docs/COMPONENT-LIBRARY.md, "Vendored surface: keep it whole") — do not re-triage them per sweep. The 3 GA4 conversion senders that sat here instead of being deleted — an uncalled CONVERSION sender is a measurement gap, and deleting it ratifies the gap — are gone: task #393 wired `login` / `sign_up` / `category_view` to real call sites, so every one of the 50 remaining entries is vendored.
